test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb, 2026 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following options is the most suitable conversion of the following sentence into active voice?

Will the final decision be announced by the committee tomorrow afternoon?

options.text: Does the committee announce the final decision tomorrow afternoon?
Is the committee announcing the final decision tomorrow afternoon?
Has the committee announced the final decision tomorrow afternoon?
Will the committee announce the final decision tomorrow afternoon?

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• To convert a sentence from passive voice to active voice, the subject and object are interchanged.
 
• The passive voice sentence is: "Will the final decision be announced by the committee tomorrow afternoon?"
 
• In the active voice, the subject "the committee" comes at the beginning of the sentence.
 
• The auxiliary verb "will" remains unchanged, and the verb "be announced" is replaced with its base form "announce."
 
• The time phrase "tomorrow afternoon" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Will the committee announce the final decision tomorrow afternoon?"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"Does the committee announce the final decision tomorrow afternoon?" – Incorrect tense (present simple instead of future simple).
 
• **Option 2: **"Is the committee announcing the final decision tomorrow afternoon?" – Incorrect tense (present continuous instead of future simple).
 
• **Option 3: **"Has the committee announced the final decision tomorrow afternoon?" – Incorrect tense (present perfect instead of future simple).
 
• **Option 4: **"Will the committee announce the final decision tomorrow afternoon?" – Correct tense and structure.
